description.en: A white rounded bubble (100×40, 10px radius) with a centered triangle arrow pointing down — a chat tooltip.
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡（100×40，10px 圆角），底部中央带向下三角箭头，聊天气泡提示。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a centered triangle arrow pointing up.
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，顶部中央带向上三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a centered triangle arrow pointing left.
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，左侧中央带向左三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a centered triangle arrow pointing right.
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，右侧中央带向右三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a triangle arrow positioned near the top-left corner (8px in).
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，左上角内侧 8px 处带三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a triangle arrow positioned near the top-right corner (8px in).
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，右上角内侧 8px 处带三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a triangle arrow positioned near the bottom-left corner (8px in).
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，左下角内侧 8px 处带三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded bubble with a triangle arrow positioned near the bottom-right corner (8px in).
description.zh: 白色圆角气泡，右下角内侧 8px 处带三角箭头。

description.en: A white rounded badge with a colored triangle in the top-right corner containing a white checkmark cutout.
description.zh: 白色圆角徽标，右上角嵌彩色三角，三角内镂空白色对勾，右上勾选角标。

description.en: A white rounded badge with a colored triangle in the bottom-right corner containing a white checkmark cutout.
description.zh: 白色圆角徽标，右下角嵌彩色三角并镂空白色对勾，右下勾选角标。

description.en: A plain square with a solid colored triangle covering the top-left corner — a corner ribbon.
description.zh: 素色方块左上角覆盖实心彩色三角，左上角折角标签。

description.en: A plain square with a solid colored triangle covering the bottom-left corner — a corner ribbon.
description.zh: 素色方块左下角覆盖实心彩色三角，左下角折角标签。

description.en: A subtle gray square with a red ribbon rotated -45deg across the top-right corner reading "HOT".
description.zh: 微灰底方块，右上角横跨 -45 度红色"HOT"缎带标签，促销角标。

description.en: A plain square with a small green dot (10px) in the top-right corner — an online status indicator.
description.zh: 素色方块右上角点缀 10px 绿色圆点，在线状态指示角标。

description.en: A square with a red rounded pill badge showing "99" pinned to the top-right corner — an unread counter.
description.zh: 方块右上角吸附红色圆角胶囊"99"徽标，未读消息计数角标。

description.en: A square with a red "waiting" label band across the top-right corner — a status tag.
description.zh: 方块右上角横跨红色"waiting"文字标签，状态标识角标。

description.en: A square with a bright green (#00d62b) "NEW" badge pinned to the top-right corner.
description.zh: 方块右上角吸附亮绿（#00d62b）"NEW"白字徽标，新品标记。

description.en: A rectangle with all four corners cut at a ~22.5deg angle via clip-path — a faceted diamond-cut octagon.
description.zh: clip-path 将四角按约 22.5 度斜切，形成宝石切割般的八角菱形。

description.en: A 3:2 rectangle whose top edge slopes right by 20px — a slanted trapezoid (parallelogram-like).
description.zh: 3:2 矩形顶边向右倾斜 20px（--p），裁出斜边梯形（平行四边形感）。

description.en: A 3:2 rectangle whose top edge slopes left by 20px — the mirrored slanted trapezoid.
description.zh: 3:2 矩形顶边向左倾斜 20px，镜像的斜边梯形。

description.en: A 3:2 rectangle with a vertical shear where the right side is offset 20px — a leaning block.
description.zh: 3:2 矩形右侧以 20px 垂直剪切偏移，倾斜的平行四边形方块。

description.en: A 3:2 rectangle with the opposite vertical shear (left side offset 20px) — a mirrored leaning block.
description.zh: 3:2 矩形左侧 20px 反向垂直剪切，镜像倾斜方块。

description.en: A rectangle with two diagonal corner cuts (50px) along the horizontal axis — a parallelogram with beveled ends.
description.zh: 矩形沿水平轴两端各斜切 50px（--p），两端倒角的平行四边形。

description.en: A rectangle with the mirrored diagonal cut (50px) in the opposite direction — a reverse parallelogram cut.
description.zh: 矩形反向 50px 对角切角，镜像的倒角平行四边形。

description.en: A rectangle with two steep diagonal cuts (30px) along the vertical axis — an angled chamfered bar.
description.zh: 矩形沿垂直轴两端 30px 陡峭斜切，斜角倒角的竖条。

description.en: A rectangle with the mirrored steep diagonal cut (30px) — a reverse vertical-bar chamfer.
description.zh: 矩形反向 30px 陡峭斜切，镜像的竖条倒角。

description.en: A beige (#eee6dd) square with its four corners masked into circles — a four-lobed clover leaf.
description.zh: 米色（#eee6dd）方块四角以遮罩处理成圆弧，形似四瓣三叶草叶片。

description.en: A pink (#fe7496) square masked into four side circles plus a center circle — a four-leaf clover.
description.zh: 粉色（#fe7496）方块以四圆（41.422%）遮罩出四瓣花瓣与中心圆，四叶草造型。

description.en: A coral (#f7694c) shape with five radial circles at pentagon vertices (37.02%) — a five-petal flower.
description.zh: 珊瑚色（#f7694c）五圆（37.02%）按五角顶点分布，五瓣花造型。

description.en: A red (#f25145) shape combining five radial flower petals with a center ring — a star-flower ring.
description.zh: 红（#f25145）五瓣放射花瓣中央叠一环孔，星花圆环造型。

description.en: A purple (#8458ff) squircle using the modern `corner-shape: squircle` with 50% radius — a true superellipse.
description.zh: 紫色（#8458ff）圆角方形，使用现代 corner-shape:squircle + 50% 圆角，完美超椭圆。

description.en: A light blue (#89daeb) rounded square with 40px corner rounding via a conic-gradient mask.
description.zh: 浅蓝（#89daeb）圆角方形，conic 遮罩实现 40px 圆角。

description.en: A rectangle with its top-left corner cut out by 70px via clip-path — a notched corner.
description.zh: clip-path 裁掉左上角 70px 的缺角矩形，标签页风格。

description.en: A rectangle with its top-right corner cut out by 70px via clip-path.
description.zh: clip-path 裁掉右上角 70px 的缺角矩形。

description.en: A rectangle with its bottom-left corner cut out by 70px via clip-path.
description.zh: clip-path 裁掉左下角 70px 的缺角矩形。

description.en: A rectangle with its bottom-right corner cut out by 70px via clip-path.
description.zh: clip-path 裁掉右下角 70px 的缺角矩形。

description.en: A rectangle with the bottom-left corner cut diagonally up to 70px — a slanted bottom-left notch.
description.zh: 矩形左下角沿 70px 斜切，右下角开口的斜切缺角。

description.en: A rectangle with the bottom-right corner cut diagonally up to 70px — a slanted bottom-right notch.
description.zh: 矩形右下角沿 70px 斜切，左下开口的斜切缺角。

description.en: A rectangle with the top-right corner cut down by 70px — a slanted top-right notch.
description.zh: 矩形右上角向下斜切 70px，右上开口的斜切缺角。

description.en: A rectangle with the top-left corner cut down by 70px — a slanted top-left notch.
description.zh: 矩形左上角向下斜切 70px，左上开口的斜切缺角。

description.en: An orange (#ff6b35) semicircle: flat top, downward arc via radial mask — a bottom half-disc.
description.zh: 橙色（#ff6b35）半圆：上平下弧（radial 遮罩），下凸半圆。

description.en: An orange semicircle with flat left edge and arc bulging right — a right half-disc.
description.zh: 橙色半圆：左平右弧，向右凸出的竖半圆。

description.en: An orange semicircle variant with the same axis — a mirrored right half-disc.
description.zh: 橙色半圆变体，同轴弧向镜像的竖半圆。

description.en: An orange semicircle with flat bottom and upward arc — a top half-disc.

description.en: An orange semicircle with flat right edge and arc bulging left — a left half-disc.
description.zh: 橙色半圆：右平左弧，向左凸出的竖半圆。

description.en: An orange semicircle variant with the arc in the mirrored orientation — a left half-disc variant.
description.zh: 橙色半圆变体，弧向镜像的左向竖半圆。

description.en: A pink (#fe7496) half-ellipse: the top half of an 85%-wide, 100%-tall ellipse via clip-path.
description.zh: 粉色（#fe7496）半椭圆：clip-path 取 85% 宽 × 100% 高椭圆的上半部。

description.en: A pink half-ellipse: the right half of a 100%-wide, 85%-tall ellipse via clip-path.
description.zh: 粉色半椭圆：clip-path 取 100% 宽 × 85% 高椭圆的右半部。

description.en: A pink flat half-ellipse: 85% wide, 50% tall — a squashed dome shape.
description.zh: 粉色扁平半椭圆：85% 宽 × 50% 高，压扁的圆顶造型。

description.en: A pink half-ellipse: the bottom half of an 85%-wide, 100%-tall ellipse via clip-path.
description.zh: 粉色半椭圆：clip-path 取 85% × 100% 椭圆的下半部。

description.en: A pink half-ellipse: the left half of a 100%-wide, 85%-tall ellipse via clip-path.
description.zh: 粉色半椭圆：clip-path 取 100% × 85% 椭圆的左半部。

description.en: A pink narrow half-ellipse: 50% wide, 85% tall — a slim vertical dome.
description.zh: 粉色细长半椭圆：50% 宽 × 85% 高，纤细的纵向穹顶。

description.zh: 方形环：#B38184 色 8px 边框，conic 遮罩裁出 30px 内方孔，方形甜甜圈。

description.en: A blue arrow button with a left notch and right arrow point — a bidirectional 6-point shape.
description.zh: 蓝色双向箭头按钮：左侧内凹、右侧箭头尖（六角裁切），双向箭头。

description.en: A blue arrow button with its left edge tapering to an arrow point while the right stays square — left-pointing.
description.zh: 蓝色按钮：左侧削成箭头尖、右侧平直（五角裁切），左向箭头按钮。

description.en: A blue button with arrow points carved on both ends via a 6-point clip-path — double-ended arrow.
description.zh: 蓝色双向箭头按钮：六角裁切两端均为箭头尖，双端箭头。

description.en: A pink (#ff7dd4) arch: top edge shaped as a dome via radial mask (85px radius) — a top arch.
description.zh: 粉色（#ff7dd4）拱形：顶部以 radial 遮罩呈 85px 圆顶，上拱门造型。

description.en: A pink arch with the bottom shaped as a dome — an inverted arch.
description.zh: 粉色拱形：底部呈圆顶，倒置拱门造型。

description.en: A pink arch with the left side shaped as a dome — a horizontal arch.
description.zh: 粉色拱形：左侧呈圆顶，横向拱门造型。

description.en: A pink arch with the right side shaped as a dome — a mirrored horizontal arch.
description.zh: 粉色拱形：右侧呈圆顶，镜像横向拱门。

description.en: An orange gear block with a full tooth protruding on its bottom side — a bottom-tooth gear.

description.zh: 橙色齿轮仅上下两边带齿，上下齿齿轮。

description.zh: 橙色齿轮块，左侧凸出单个齿，左齿齿轮。

description.en: An orange gear block with a full tooth protruding on its top side — a top-tooth gear.
description.zh: 橙色齿轮块，顶部凸出单个齿，顶齿齿轮。

description.en: An orange (#F07818) rounded rectangle (1.2:1) with a semicircular notch recessed into its top edge via mask.
description.zh: 橙色（#F07818）圆角矩形（1.2:1），顶部边缘以遮罩内凹半圆缺口。

description.en: An orange rounded rectangle with a semicircular notch recessed near its top-left edge.
description.zh: 橙色圆角矩形，左上边缘内凹半圆缺口。

description.en: An orange rounded rectangle with a semicircular notch recessed into its left edge.
description.zh: 橙色圆角矩形，左侧边缘内凹半圆缺口。
